metadata.description: Fleet → vessel → check date: health, findings, systems, checklist, analysis, noon report and track for the 5 pilot vessels, read live from nyk_mti (living_office.* case file + m0_check_reports.* + noon_report.*). Every card carries its data mapping (ⓘ); play steps the date and every graph follows. Overview opens with the UMS verdict (safe to go unmanned for the next 8 h?) computed per check from POC rules — one card per Skill-2 cluster.
